in_sanskrit.name: Bandu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Strong, Powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bandu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bandhana' meaning 'bondage' or 'attachment'. In Hindu mythology, Bandu is a name of Lord Shiva, representing strength, power, and protection.

in_tamil.name: Bandu
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Strong, Powerful
in_tamil.long_meaning: Bandu ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bandhana' meaning 'bondage' or 'attachment'. In Hindu mythology, Bandu is a name of Lord Shiva, representing strength, power, and protection.

in_telugu.name: Bandu
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bandu ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bandhana' meaning 'bondage' or 'attachment'. In Hindu mythology, Bandu is a name of Lord Shiva, representing strength, power, and protection.

in_marathi.name: Bandu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bandu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bandhana' meaning 'bondage' or 'attachment'. In Hindu mythology, Bandu is a name of Lord Shiva, representing strength, power, and protection.

in_bengali.name: Bandu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Strong, Powerful
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bandu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bandhana' meaning 'bondage' or 'attachment'. In Hindu mythology, Bandu is a name of Lord Shiva, representing strength, power, and protection.
